parsed_json.up: Select compound_chembl_id (molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), canonical_smiles (compound_structures.canonical_smiles), compound_key (compound_records.compound_key), pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer docs.pubmed_id, fallback docs.doi), assay_description (assays.description), standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id (target_dictionary.chembl_id), target_name (target_dictionary.pref_name), target_organism (target_dictionary.organism). Join molecule_dictionary INNER JOIN compound_structures on molregno, INNER JOIN compound_records on molregno, INNER JOIN activities on activities.record_id = compound_records.record_id, INNER JOIN assays on activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id, INNER JOIN target_dictionary on assays.tid = target_dictionary.tid, INNER JOIN docs on activities.doc_id = docs.doc_id. Filter target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3397', activities.standard_type = 'IC50', compound_structures.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL, docs.pubmed_id IS NOT NULL OR docs.doi IS NOT NULL. Do not deduplicate; preserve all qualifying activity rows. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
